review_method: Direct inspection of all fourteen full-page 110-dpi renders using view_image; manuscript read in full.

page_notes.1: Title/name/email, revised abstract and motivation fit cleanly; no unsupported calibrated-performance claim.
page_notes.2: Condition equation, ePIC scope and geometry graph/counts checked; geometry panels and caption legible.
page_notes.3: Training/development populations and architecture cascade clear; arrows and stage colors match caption.
page_notes.4: Response/activity/flow equations 2-6 fit; numerical floors and raw-deposit meaning explained.
page_notes.5: Solver, budget, graph message passing and fixed-count sampler equations 7-10 legible.
page_notes.6: Channel flow, decoder, losses and checkpoint selection clear; all equations fit.
page_notes.7: Gap/run/component definitions and aggregate bound verified; uncertainty and C2ST limitations stated.
page_notes.8: All 14 aggregate table rows and longitudinal-energy panels/caption fit without clipping.
page_notes.9: Component-bound figure and labels clear; algebraic ranges explicitly distinguished from confidence intervals.
page_notes.10: Failed classifier/tolerance findings retained; mechanism hypothesis and physical-sensitivity limits clear.
page_notes.11: Conclusion consistent with bounds; availability, mentorship, author and AI declarations all fit on page.
page_notes.12: Appendix A hashes, calibration weights, settings and reproducibility/test-history limits legible.
page_notes.13: Appendix B includes every energy bin and all classifier seeds, plus split caveat; no table overflow.
page_notes.14: All 22 bibliography entries and links fit; no missing references or clipped lines.

scientific_boundary: Document and algebra review, not new event-level validation or a journal-readiness certification.
